implementation_summary: Established the first small, executable, repository-owned deterministic testing foundation for Agent Governance. Created a non-package virtual Python development harness via root .python-version (3.13), pyproject.toml (Python >=3.13, uv required-version >=0.11.32,<0.12, pytest>=9,<10 and ruff>=0.16,<0.17 dev dependencies, Ruff configuration that explicitly excludes committed Markdown), and a committed uv.lock generated by uv 0.11.33. Authored four deterministic test modules under tests/ covering (1) canonical source layout including required Core modules and the protocol-1.9.0 COEXISTENCE.md, (2) direct local reference integrity for AGENTS.md and every governance-core module, (3) source-product vs. installed consumer-footprint separation with a self-describing synthetic consumer fixture, and (4) harness-foundation sanity (locked pytest discovery, locked ruff invocation, no required production credentials, failures identify the violated invariant). Persisted the executor handoff under handoffs/ per D021/D022.
implementation_rationale: Selected a non-package virtual project (tool.uv.package = false) because T001 does not need a build backend; declared Python 3.13 at minor-series granularity per D025; pinned dev dependencies to exactly pytest and Ruff per the task's first-increment scope (no Hypothesis, no type checkers, no coverage, no Make, no Node). Configured Ruff to extend-exclude **/*.md so executor tooling cannot rewrite ChatGPT-owned Markdown (D016 protection). Used a session-scoped repo_root fixture in conftest.py plus a tiny tests/_helpers.py to share reference-extraction logic and avoid duplication across the four test modules. The reference-integrity test deliberately ignores consumer-side .agent-coordination/ and .agent-governance/ paths because the Core documents consumer-installation paths that must not exist at the source repository root; this is a separation invariant, not a missing reference. The test also ignores glob/branch-pattern tokens, plain directory tokens like handoffs/, and extension-only tokens like .md because they are valid prose that does not point at a single on-disk file.
